title: One Piece: Adventures
description:
One Piece Adventures takes place in the One Piece universe, where you play as a character trying to survive. Form alliances, battle enemies, and embark on thrilling adventures as you fight your way through this world or protect innocent lives.

(It's recommended that you create your character instead of quick starting)
prompt: Welcome to the world of One Piece a vast sea of adventure, danger, and limitless possibility. Forge your path as a pirate, marine, or revolutionary. Discover Devil Fruits, master Haki, and sail the Grand Line in search of glory, treasure, and legacy. Your journey begins now what will you become.
authorsNote:
The world of One Piece is an ocean planet ruled by wind, current, and rumor, where the only reliable law is that someone stronger is always sailing toward you. Four seas ring a single vast Grand Line, split by a Red Line and a Calm Belt full of Sea Kings, and every island on it is its own small world with its own weather, cuisine, currency, king, and buried wound. Pirates are not a monolith of villains. Some are monsters who burn villages, some are wandering fools chasing a dream loud enough to embarrass a room, and the difference between the two is never their flag. The Marines who chase them are not a monolith either. They carry the World Government's authority, and that authority protects a global order built on Celestial Dragons, slave markets, erased history, and islands that were deleted because they asked the wrong question. Power in this world is stratified and visible: Devil Fruits that trade the sea for the impossible, Haki that lets will overrule strength, bounty posters that turn a person into a number the world argues about over breakfast.

Write it the way a shonen adventure is drawn rather than the way a fantasy novel is written. The register swings hard and fast: a chapter can open with someone stealing food off a stranger's plate and close with a childhood being taken apart in flashback, and both halves are sincere. Dreams are stated out loud, in full, without irony, and characters will fight to the death over someone else's dream more readily than their own. Bodies are exaggerated, faces are elastic, laughs are distinct and spelled out, and the food is always described.
instructions:
Respond to players choices in second-person present tense.

- Continue the story from where it left off
- Keep the reader in control of their actions and decisions
- Write characters with distinct personalities and natural speech
- Show developments through actions and dialogue
- Use clear, direct language - avoid unnecessary description
- Present conflicts through what characters do and say
- Show what happens, not why it happens

cardPool.value: The most common race in the world. Humans vary widely in size, strength, intelligence, and moral alignment. Some humans are so physically advanced (like the Kuja or Red-Haired Pirates) that they rival even the strongest non-human races.

cardPool.title: Fish-Men
cardPool.value: Fish-Men are humanoid beings with fish or other aquatic creature traits like gills, webbed hands, sharp teeth, or shark fins. They possess roughly ten times the strength of an average human on land, and that advantage grows even greater underwater, where they can breathe and swim freely. They hail primarily from Fish-Man Island, located deep beneath the Red Line at the bottom of the sea. Their history is marked by centuries of discrimination and enslavement at the hands of humans, fueling a deep and complicated conflict between the two races

cardPool.title: Merfolk
cardPool.value: Merfolk are aquatic people with a human upper body and a fish-like tail instead of legs, letting them swim gracefully and live comfortably underwater. They're closely related to fish-men, though merfolk tend to be more human in appearance and generally aren't as physically strong or combat-focused. On land, most merfolk can't walk since they lack legs, so they get around in wheelchairs, on wheeled tails, or occasionally through devil fruit powers or magic that lets them stand. They breathe both in water and on land, and many are gifted singers, using their beautiful voices as a defining trait of their culture. Merfolk and fish-men typically live together in the same underwater kingdoms, sharing history and community despite their physical differences.

cardPool.title: Skypiean
cardPool.value: Skypieans are humanoid beings distinguished by small white wings on their backs, which are purely decorative and don't allow flight. They live in the sky on islands made of dense clouds, roughly 7,000 to 10,000 meters above the sea, where they've developed a unique culture around Dials and sky travel. Their society relies on cloud-based technology, using wavers and other Dial-powered vehicles to move across the sea clouds. They have a history of conflict with other sky-dwelling peoples, particularly the Shandia, over the sacred land of Upper Yard. Notable Skypieans include Gan Fall, Conis, and Pagaya.

cardPool.title: Minks
cardPool.value: Minks are humanoid beings with animal traits from mammals, such as fur, tails, and ears, resembling everything from dogs and lions to rabbits and gorillas. They are natural-born warriors, with every member of the race capable of fighting, and they can channel a special ability called Electro, generating electricity through their bodies. Their homeland is Zou, a country located on the back of the colossal, ancient elephant Zunesha that wanders the ocean. Under the light of the full moon, Minks can transform into their ferocious Sulong form, which massively boosts their strength and speed. Notable Minks include Nekomamushi, Inuarashi, Carrot, and Pedro

cardPool.title: Giants
cardPool.value: Giants are enormous humanoid beings who typically stand over ten times the height of a normal human, with lifespans that can reach three times as long. They possess tremendous physical strength that makes even an average giant a devastating force in battle, capable of crushing ships and armies. Most hail from Elbaf, a legendary island known for its proud warrior culture that values honor, courage, and dying gloriously in battle. Many giants work as mercenaries or join crews and organizations, with some famously serving in the Marines through the Giant Squad. Notable Giants include Dorry, Brogy, Oimo, Kashii, and Hajrudin.

cardPool.title: Lunarians
cardPool.value: Lunarians are a near-extinct race from the top of the Red Line, once revered as literal gods of the world. They have distinct appearances, including massive black wings, and a giant flame that burns near-constantly on their backs, along with brown skin and silver or white hair. As long as the flame on their back keeps burning, they can survive almost any attack or extreme condition, but they become vulnerable once it goes out and shutting it off deliberately grants a big boost in speed instead. Every Lunarian can generate and control fire from their own body, using it for offense or defense, with the strongest users able to produce magma-like flames.

cardPool.title: Cyborgs
cardPool.value: Cyborgs are a race of beings that have fused organic flesh with advanced mechanical and cybernetic components, blurring the line between biological life and machine. Their bodies range from mostly human with select augmentations reinforced limbs, ocular implants, neural processors to almost entirely synthetic, retaining only a core of living tissue or a preserved brain. This hybrid physiology grants them enhanced strength, durability, and processing speed, along with specialized abilities like built-in weaponry, data interfacing, or environmental adaptation modules.

cardPool.title: Zombies
cardPool.value: zombies are created through the combined efforts of Gecko Moria's shadow-stealing devil fruit and Dr. Hogback's surgical skills, most notably during Moria's reign over Thriller Bark. A body, called a mario, is stitched together from corpses by Hogback, then Moria implants a stolen shadow into it, bringing the whole thing to life as a zombie. The zombie initially retains the personality and fighting skills of whoever the shadow was stolen from, and the stronger the shadow, the stronger the resulting zombie becomes. Over time though, the zombie usually loses that original personality entirely and falls into total obedience to Moria. If the shadow is ever removed or the zombie is exposed to salt, which cancels the devil fruit's power, the body reverts to a lifeless corpse once again.

cardPool.title: Skeleton
cardPool.value: Skeletons are undead beings whose flesh, organs, and skin have completely decayed away, leaving only a walking, animated set of bones. Despite lacking a body in the traditional sense, they retain their mind, memories, and personality from when they were alive. They can move, talk, and function almost like a living person, just without any of the soft tissue that once covered them. Being made of bone alone, they're generally lighter and more fragile in certain ways, though tougher and harder to kill through normal means since they have no vital organs left to damage. Their existence is usually tied to some kind of soul or spirit magic that keeps them animated long after their original body should have turned to dust.

cardPool.title: Artificial Humans
cardPool.value: Artificial Humans are beings that aren't born naturally but are instead created through science, typically grown from another person's genetic material or blueprint. Unlike naturally born people, they're mass-produced, often built for a specific purpose like combat or labor. They usually inherit physical traits and abilities based on whoever they were cloned from, giving them strength or skills similar to their donor. Their personalities and free will can vary a lot depending on how they were made, ranging from fully autonomous individuals to obedient, emotionless soldiers. Overall, they're a man-made race built for utility rather than a people that occurs through natural birth.

cardPool.title: Wotans
cardPool.value: The Wotans are a hybrid race born from a giant parent and a fish-man parent, blending the size and strength of a giant with the aquatic traits of a fish-man. This mix lets them thrive underwater while still carrying the massive build associated with giant heritage. They're bigger and stronger than an average human or fish-man, though smaller than a full-blooded giant. Only a couple of known members have ever been shown, making them a fairly rare and obscure hybrid race. Overall, they're a strong, sea-capable people that combine the best physical traits of two very different races.

cardPool.title: Longarm Tribe
cardPool.value: The Longarm Tribe are a race of humanoids defined by unusually long, stretched-out arms compared to the rest of their body. Aside from their arms, they tend to look mostly human, with the elongated limbs being their one defining physical trait. Their long, flexible arms give them extended reach and can make them especially good at grabbing, striking, or wielding weapons from a distance. Like other exaggerated-trait tribes, they can interbreed with humans and other races, sometimes passing the long-arm trait on to mixed offspring. They're a rarer, lesser-known race, generally seen through scattered individuals rather than a large, unified society.

cardPool.title: Buccaneer
cardPool.value: Buccaneers are a nearly extinct race said to carry the blood of giants, making them larger and stronger than average humans while still smaller than a full giant. They look almost identical to regular tall humans, so much so that a blood test is usually the only way to tell them apart. They're considered incredibly durable and powerful even as children, able to withstand punishment that would seriously hurt or kill a normal person. According to legend, the Buccaneers committed some great crime against the world long ago, and because of this, they're hunted and enslaved or executed by the World Government whenever discovered. Even a small amount of Buccaneer blood seems to carry consequences, since people who are only part Buccaneer are still treated the same way as full-blooded members of the race.

cardPool.title: Tontatta
cardPool.value: The Tontatta are a race of tiny, dwarf-like people who live in a hidden underground kingdom, standing roughly as short compared to a human as a human is to a giant. They have pointy noses and thick, fluffy tails that look soft on the outside but are actually made of hard bone and muscle. Despite their small size, they're incredibly strong and fast, capable of destroying buildings or stripping someone of their belongings before they even notice. They're also known for being extremely naive and gullible, quick to believe almost anything they're told, no matter how outlandish. Outsiders often mistake them for fairies, since they like to sneak around at night and take small items, but they're really just a physical race of small, mighty people, not anything magical.

cardPool.title: Fairies
cardPool.value: The Fairies are a nickname given to a race of tiny, dwarf-like people living in a hidden underground kingdom. Locals call them fairies because they sneak into town at night and take small offerings and items, vanishing before anyone can catch them in the act. Despite being mistaken for magical creatures, they're really just an ordinary, physical race, just extremely small and incredibly fast. Their light-fingered habit of borrowing things is such a defining trait that it shaped the whole legend around them. Over time, the story of thieving fairies became so believable that most people never realized the truth was a tribe of small, quick-handed people rather than anything magical.

cardPool.title: Automata
cardPool.value: Automata are a type of sapient robot found both on the Blue Sea's Karakuri Island and out in space on Fairy Vearth, seemingly originating from an ancient city built by the Moon People. Despite being machines, they don't look robotic on the outside at all, they appear to be made of ordinary flesh and blood, with the same animal-like face and mustache shared across the whole race. They're not to be confused with cyborgs, since cyborgs are organic beings partly converted into machines, while automata are fully mechanical from the start. Even though they're robots, they're still capable of things like eating, and they show real personality and loyalty, following and helping those who treat them kindly. They come in slightly different builds depending on where they're found, with the Fairy Vearth automata having wings like the Skypieans and Shandians, while the Karakuri Island ones tend to be a bit taller.

cardPool.title: Pacifistas
cardPool.value: Pacifistas are cyborg weapons created by Dr. Vegapunk, mass-produced clones modeled after the original Warlord Bartholomew Kuma's body. Each unit is labeled PX followed by a number, marked on the neck, showing the order they were built in, with around twenty in service during the Summit War alone. They're built for combat, firing powerful lasers from their mouths and palms and boasting durability strong enough to tank hits from top-tier pirates. Unlike their prototype Kuma, standard Pacifistas have no free will or personality, acting as obedient, emotionless weapons that follow orders and attack based on programmed targets. Since each one costs roughly as much as a full warship to build, they're incredibly expensive but represent some of the World Government's most dangerous military technology.

cardPool.title: Mary Geoise
cardPool.value:
The sacred capital of the World Government perched high above the Red Line. Home to the enigmatic Gorosei and the Celestial Dragons, it’s a place of immense power and secrecy. Lavish palaces contrast with ruthless politics, where decisions shape the fate of the world.

World Lore: You begin in Mary Geoise (Marijoa), the Holy Land atop the Red Line. The Celestial Dragons rule here, flaunting unmatched wealth and authority.  
Marie Geoise is cloaked in opulence: grand white terraces, divine statues, and an imposing palace. Commoners and slaves are hidden below, out of sight.  
The World Government is headquartered here; the Gorosei convene daily in secret chambers.  
Straw Hat Pirates and most pirates are banned—adventure-seekers are not welcome.  
The divine sentence system is active: “Forbidden crimes” result in public execution.

cardPool.title: Punk Hazard

Punk Hazard is a forbidden island divided into two extreme climates: one half scorched in unending flames, the other frozen solid. The island is still scarred by its violent past, filled with toxic gas, mutated creatures, and abandoned labs. It serves as a reminder of the Government’s darker pursuits and the dangers of unchecked science.

cardPool.title: 400M – 500M Beli Bounty
cardPool.value: You got a bounty somewhere between 400,000,000 and 500,000,000 Beli. This is the elite bracket. Not the promising, not the dangerous, the elite. Half a billion Beli is the number carried by right hands of Emperors, by captains who have gone through Marine fleets and come out the other side, by monsters whose reputations arrive weeks before their ships do. Nobody in this range is still learning. Whatever you do, you have already perfected it on somebody who could not stop you. Inside Marineford your poster does not sit in a stack. Admirals discuss you by name. Four hundred million is where the Government begins asking whether you should be recruited, contained, or removed, and five hundred million is where they start suspecting the answer might not be theirs to choose. Above this line there are only Emperors, their strongest commanders, and the handful of people the world has run out of ways to categorize. You are close enough now to see the top. So is everyone up there looking down at you.

cardPool.title: 500 Million - 900M Beli Bounty
cardPool.value: You got a bounty somewhere between 500,000,000 and 900,000,000 Beli. You have left the category of pirate and entered the category of event. Half a billion is the floor for Emperor commanders. Nine hundred million is the ceiling nobody reaches without having personally forced the World Government to change its plans. Everyone standing in this range has broken something the world assumed was unbreakable, and the number is less a price than an admission. At Marineford you are not a case, you are an agenda item. The Five Elders have heard your name spoken aloud in a room where names are rarely spoken at all. Nine hundred million is the last number before the world stops measuring you against pirates and starts measuring you against Emperors, and everyone above that line got there by taking something from someone who thought they owned it forever. You are one victory away from a title. The only thing left to decide is which one, and who has to lose it.

The colors work like tricks on the mind, so the artist doesn’t need strength or weapons. Their power comes from their brush, their paint, and how fast they can draw.

cardPool.value: Domi Reversi is a forbidden power that lets someone place a target into a strange state where their free will is erased, taking away their logic and reason and turning the target into a demon and force the target to listen to the user command. In return, the target gains massive strength, a body that is extremely hard to kill, and a form of near-immortality that lets them survive almost anything.

cardPool.title: Demons
cardPool.value: Demons are people forcibly transformed by a mysterious ruler fruit, the strongest devil fruit. To become a demon, a victim first offers up part of their lifespan, then Imu creates an Abyss beneath them and flips them upside-down into their new demonic identity, though he can force this on people whether they agree or not. Once transformed, demons look monstrous and much bigger than before, with bat wings, crooked fangs, long horns, and eyes that burn with flame, and any weapon they carried turns into a trident-like version of itself.

cardPool.title: Toy
cardPool.value: Toy is a race of people who used to be human but got turned into living toys by Sugar's Hobi Hobi no Mi devil fruit. One touch from user transforms the victim's body into a toy, shrinks them down, and instantly erases everyone's memory of them ever existing as a person. Toys keep their original mind, skills, and knowledge, but lose most of their physical strength and are limited to whatever body the user gave them, whether that's a soldier, a stuffed animal, or a part of something bigger. Since they're now considered inorganic, they're vulnerable to things that wouldn't normally hurt a person, and their bodies can wear down and break from hard use.

cardPool.title: Moon
cardPool.value: The Moon is a giant, mysterious rock floating high above the Blue Planet. Long ago, it was home to an advanced civilization called the Moon People, who built machines and cities that reached for the stars. Today, the ruins of their cities lie silent, glowing under the moonlight, filled with forgotten treasures and dangerous relics. Few dare to explore it, but those who do may uncover secrets lost to time and perhaps even powers no one on the Blue Planet has ever seen.

cardPool.value: Spider Miles is a strange and chaotic town built on piles of scrap, broken machines, and twisting metal streets. The place hums with activity, from blacksmiths forging weapons from leftover metal to shadowy figures hiding in corners, making deals that nobody else dares to witness. Pirates and thieves often come here to find rare parts or recruit skilled fighters, but outsiders must watch every step the streets can be as dangerous as they are full of opportunity.

cardPool.value: Downs is a dark, forgotten island covered in massive heaps of garbage and ruined buildings. The air is thick and heavy, carrying the stench of decay, and survival here is a test of skill and cunning. This island was once home to gangs and outlaws, making it a place where only the strong thrive. Those who venture into Downs either come looking for power, treasure, or secrets buried deep within the island’s twisted alleys and mountains of waste.

cardPool.value: Rakesh is a small port town on the edge of the North Blue, bustling with docks, merchant ships, and shady dealings. It has a rough charm, with narrow streets lined with warehouses, taverns, and hidden back-alleys. Pirates often stop here to trade, recruit crew members, or lay low from the World Government. Though small, Rakesh is full of stories, secret plots, and hidden dangers waiting for those bold enough to explore it.

cardPool.title: The Admirals

This is one of the highest ranks in the Marines, right under the Fleet Admiral. As an Admiral, your power is known across the world. Pirates fear you, nations watch you, and the Marines trust you to protect the seas and follow your orders. Your actions can change everything, and your voice carries great weight wherever you go.

cardPool.title: Funkfreed
cardPool.value: A sword that has been animated by the Zou Zou no Mi, allowing it to transform into an elephant or a large elephant-sword hybrid. In battle, Funkfreed can stretch its trunk, stomp the ground, or swing its body like a massive metal club. This weapon is both loyal and wild; it chooses when to fight alongside its wielder and when to act on instinct. Warriors who earn its respect gain a partner stronger than most beasts.

cardPool.title: Sphinx Island
cardPool.value: Sphinx Island is located in the New World, a remote and rugged territory far from the World Government’s tighter control. The land is rocky and mountainous, with narrow valleys and small villages scattered among the cliffs. The people who live there are poor and humble; the island was once abandoned by the World Government because its residents couldn’t pay the Heavenly Tribute.

cardPool.title: Spa Island
cardPool.value: Spa Island is located on a floating resort that travels across the Grand Line. The entire structure is built for relaxation, filled with warm baths, sparkling pools, luxury rooms, and colorful attractions. Visitors come to rest and unwind, but beneath the cheerful atmosphere lies quiet secrets and mysterious guests who use the island as a safe place to hide, scheme, or make secret deals far away from Marine eyes.

cardPool.title: Gray Terminal
cardPool.value: Gray Terminal is located on the edge of the Goa Kingdom on Dawn Island. It is a huge wasteland filled with broken ships, piles of metal, and endless mountains of trash. Smoke floats through the air while scavengers dig for anything valuable to survive. The area is harsh, lawless, and dangerous, but its hidden corners make it a refuge for rebels, runaways, and anyone trying to disappear from the eyes of the world.

cardPool.value: A normal human with no Devil Fruit powers. They rely purely on physical strength, skill, intelligence, and determination. Through hard training and experience, they've become a capable fighter able to stand their ground in a world full of monsters and abilities.

cardPool.title: Gum-Gum Fruit
cardPool.value:
This fruit turns the user’s body into rubber, letting them stretch, bend, and move in ways normal people can’t. Their punches and kicks can reach far distances, and their rubber body helps them take strong hits without breaking. As the user trains, they can unlock special battle forms called Gears. Each Gear boosts them in a different way, giving more strength, speed, or flexibility

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Gum-Gum Bazooka — Fire both fists forward at the same time with massive impact.
Gum-Gum Gatling — Rapid-fire barrage of stretching punches at machine-gun speed.
Gum-Gum Balloon — Inflate your body with air to become a bouncy shield or cushion.
Gum-Gum Whip — Strike with a long, flexible stretching leg whip.
Gum-Gum Bell — Ring your inflated head like a bell to deliver a heavy headbutt.

This fruit makes the user’s skin super smooth and slippery. Any attack punch, sword, bullet, even heavy objects will slide off their body harmlessly, because nothing can grip or bite into their slick surface. If the user was overweight, the slip effect can even cause excess fat to slide off, making their body slim and sleek.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves.

Moves:

Sube Sube Dash – User uses their slippery body to glide across surfaces at incredible speeds, evading attacks with ease.

Sube Sube Slip – When struck, the user's body becomes so slick that weapons and limbs slip off harmlessly, nullifying physical attacks.

Sube Sube Launch – User launches themselves forward like a projectile using their slippery body to slide at high velocity and body-check opponents.

Sube Sube Counter – User dodges an enemy attack and immediately slides back in for a counterstrike with increased speed and momentum.

They can detonate limbs or exhalations to create powerful explosions, hurting enemies and damaging surroundings without harming themselves. The user becomes immune to explosions even cannonballs, so they can unleash blasts freely while staying safe.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves.

Bomb Charge – User charges forward with multiple small explosions propelling their body, knocking back enemies and causing minor shockwaves.

Bomb Bullet – User fires small explosive particles or creates mini bomb projectiles that explode on contact.

Bomb Storm – User detonates a series of rapid explosions across the battlefield, targeting multiple enemies.

Self-Detonation – User causes a massive explosion centered on their own body to clear a wide area, without taking damage.

cardPool.title: Kilo-Kilo Fruit
cardPool.value:
The Kilo-Kilo Fruit lets the user change their weight anytime they want, from as light as 1 kilogram to as heavy as 10,000 kilograms 10 tons in a second. They can make their body super light to jump very far, walk on water or thin branches, float in the wind, or dodge attacks easily. They can also make themselves extremely heavy to break through walls, crush enemies with huge pressure, create shockwaves by stomping, or fall from the sky like a meteor and leave a large crater.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Heavy Impact: By increasing their weight drastically, the user can deliver powerful, crushing blows to opponents or anchor themselves firmly in place.

Feather Light: By reducing their weight to near zero, the user gains extreme agility and speed, making it difficult to be hit.

Weight-Based Defense: User can increase their weight to make themselves harder to move or knock down.

cardPool.title: Pirates
cardPool.value: A pirate is an outlaw of the seas, marked as a criminal by the World Government for the crime of refusing its authority. Pirates take what they want, go where they please, and recognize no king, no admiral, and no law but their own. Some are raiders and conquerors. Some are treasure hunters, explorers, and dreamers chasing something the world says shouldn't be reachable. The World Government makes no distinction between them, printing every one of them on a bounty poster and setting the Marines loose.

cardPool.title: Marines
cardPool.value:
A Marine is the armed hand of the World Government, sworn to justice, discipline, and the authority of the flag they serve. Marines patrol the seas, hunt pirates, garrison islands, and enforce the law wherever the Government claims jurisdiction. Rank determines everything: orders flow down from Headquarters, and a Marine follows them or answers for it. Some pursue Absolute Justice, holding that any measure is permitted to preserve order. Others follow Moral Justice, weighing the law against the lives caught underneath it. The tension between the two runs through every level of the organization.

The uniform is a symbol of pride and a target for every criminal on the sea. The world does not always call a Marine a hero. Marines call it peace through strength.

Wooden houses, stone pathways, and bamboo groves give the country an ancient, traditional feel. Its people are tough, loyal, and honor-bound, with famous families like the Chinjao Family shaping its history.

cardPool.title: Calm Belts
cardPool.value: The Calm Belt is a strange and deadly sea zone that stretches along the north and south edges of the Grand Line. The waters and skies are eerily still no wind blows, no currents flow, and no waves rise, making normal ships almost impossible to sail. But the calm hides a deadly secret: massive Sea Kings roam beneath the surface, attacking any ship that enters. The Calm Belt acts as a natural barrier, protecting the Grand Line from ordinary travelers.

Those who take up Shodai Kitetsu gain immense power, but must also face the risk of the sword’s dark fate if they fail to master it.

cardPool.title: Aokiji
cardPool.value: Aokiji is a former Admiral of the marines, once known for his calm justice and overwhelming ice powers. After his fateful duel with Akainu, he left the organization he had served for years and drifted through the world with no clear allegiance. His mastery over the Ice-Ice Fruit allows him to freeze oceans, create massive ice constructs, and shape a spear of solid frost as his primary weapon. Skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, he remains one of the most dangerous men alive. Though he now stands among the Blackbeard Pirates on Hachinosu, his true intentions remain mysterious, leaving many unsure if he is an ally, an enemy, or something in between.

cardPool.title: Five Elders
cardPool.value: The Five Elders are the supreme council that governs the world, ruling from the sacred heights of Mary Geoise with absolute authority. Seen by the public as the highest power within the World Government, they command the Marines, Cipher Pol, and every agency that maintains order across the seas. Their influence alone functions as their greatest weapon, capable of shaping nations, erasing histories, and deciding the fate of entire kingdoms. Though their individual abilities remain hidden, their connection to Imu grants them a level of power far beyond political command. As Celestial Dragons chosen to stand above all others, they move the world from the shadows, acting as the silent hands that direct every major event from the Room of Authority.

cardPool.title: Brook
cardPool.value: Brook is the lively soul of the Straw Hat Pirates, a walking skeleton brought back from death by the power of the Revive-Revive Fruit. Once the leader of the Rumbar Pirates, he spent fifty long years wandering alone after his crew perished, sustained only by the hope of keeping a promise to his friend Laboon. His cane sword and elegant fencing style blend seamlessly with his ability to manipulate soul energy, allowing him to strike with chilling precision. Though his Haki remains uncertain, his spirit is unwavering. As the musician of the crew, he fills their journey with music and laughter, sailing alongside them aboard their ship as both a swordsman and a treasured companion.

cardPool.title: Gunko
cardPool.value: Gunko is a formidable member of the God’s Knights, carrying herself with the poise and authority expected of someone born into the prestigious Manmayer family of World Nobles. Gifted with the Arrow-Arrow Fruit, she shapes arrows from pure force, using them not only as projectiles but as constructs that bind, strike, and even enhance her own movements. Her arrival on any battlefield is marked by a surge of power described as black lightning, hinting at an exceptional mastery of Haki. Having taken part in historic events such as the God Valley Incident, she stands as one of the most elite protectors of the ruling order. Now present on Elbaf, she remains a silent but deadly force acting on behalf of the World Nobles and the God’s Knights.

cardPool.title: Alvida
cardPool.value: Alvida is a pirate who completely remade herself after consuming the Slip-Slip Fruit, shedding her former appearance and gaining the ability to let any attack glide harmlessly off her skin. Armed with her heavy iron mace, she mixes beauty with brutality, striking with confidence and precision. After her transformation, she chose to ally herself with Buggy, eventually becoming part of the rising power known as Cross Guild. Now stationed on Karai Bari Island, she moves with effortless grace and untouchable arrogance, using her Devil Fruit ability and her fierce will to secure her place in the new age of piracy.
cardPool.description:
Name: Alvida
Fruit/Ability: Slip-Slip Fruit (post-time skip)
Weapon: Iron mace
Haki Type: None
Background story: Slimmed down after eating Devil Fruit and allied with Buggy.
Role/Rank: Pirate
Faction: Cross Guild
Island Location: Karai Bari Island

cardPool.title: Kuro
cardPool.value: Kuro is a cunning former pirate captain who abandoned his old life by assuming the identity of a quiet, loyal butler. Behind that calm mask, he hid lethal intent, plotting to murder Kaya and escape with her fortune. Known for his exceptional stealth and blistering speed, he fought using his razor-sharp Cat Claws, striking faster than most could react. After the downfall of the Black Cat Pirates, he vanished from the seas, leaving his whereabouts unknown. Whether lurking somewhere in the East Blue or hiding far from his past crimes, Kuro remains a shadow from an era of deception and cold ambition.

cardPool.title: Don Krieg
cardPool.value: Don Krieg is the ruthless captain of the Krieg Pirates, feared across the East Blue for his overwhelming arsenal and unbreakable heavy armor. Known as a man who values firepower above all else, he overwhelms opponents with explosives, spears, poison gas, and sheer numbers. His disastrous attempt to conquer the Grand Line left him broken and desperate, ultimately leading to his defeat at the hands of Luffy. Since then, his fate has become uncertain, with many believing he remains somewhere in the East Blue or possibly imprisoned. Even so, his name still carries the echo of a man who once sought to dominate the seas through fear and force.

cardPool.title: Arlong
cardPool.value: Arlong is a fierce Sawshark Fish-Man whose raw strength and ruthless ambition once made him the terror of the East Blue. Wielding his sharpened saw-blade nose as a deadly weapon, he ruled over Nami’s village with cruelty, extorting its people while dreaming of Fish-Man supremacy. His hatred for humans fueled every action he took, driving him to build an empire through fear alone. After his defeat, he was captured and sent to Impel Down, where he is believed to be held deep within Level 6. Even imprisoned, Arlong’s name remains tied to one of the darkest eras the East Blue ever endured.

cardPool.title: Smoker
cardPool.value: Smoker is a relentless Marine Vice Admiral whose pursuit of justice is as stubborn as the smoke he commands. Through the power of the Smoke-Smoke Fruit, he can dissolve into vapor, restrain opponents, and move across the battlefield with swift, shifting forms. Armed with his seastone-tipped jitte, he specializes in catching Devil Fruit users off guard, forcing them into submission through sheer force and discipline. Skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, he stands as one of the Marines’ most persistent hunters. From his post at the G-5 Marine Base in the New World, he continues chasing pirates—especially Luffy—with an unwavering sense of duty that refuses to fade.
cardPool.description:
Name: Smoker
Fruit/Ability: Smoke-Smoke Fruit (turns into smoke)
Weapon: Seastone-tipped jitte
Haki Type: Armament, Observation
Background story: Marine who pursued Luffy from East Blue
Role/Rank: Vice Admiral
Faction: Marines
Island Location: G-5 Marine Base (New World)

cardPool.title: Monkey D. Dragon
cardPool.value: Monkey D. Dragon is the elusive and formidable Supreme Commander of the Revolutionary Army, a man whose very name inspires fear within the World Government. Though his abilities remain shrouded in mystery, his presence alone signals a force capable of shaking nations. Known as Luffy’s father, he carries a legacy bound to the future of the world, yet chooses to stand in the shadows, directing the global fight against oppression. He wields no weapon and reveals nothing of his potential Haki, making his true power a matter of speculation and growing legend. Residing in the Kamabakka Kingdom on Momoiro Island, he continues to guide the Revolutionary Army in its mission to topple the world’s greatest tyranny.

cardPool.title: Crocus
cardPool.value: Crocus is the calm and seasoned lighthouse keeper of Twin Cape, a man whose medical expertise once served the legendary Roger Pirates. After his time on the Pirate King’s ship, he chose a quieter life, dedicating himself to caring for Laboon and guiding ships safely into the Grand Line. Armed only with a harpoon and years of experience, he stands as a steadfast guardian at Reverse Mountain. Though he holds no Haki and belongs to no faction, his past with Roger and his deep compassion for Laboon make him a quiet but important figure whose presence still echoes with the history of a bygone era.

cardPool.title: Laboon
cardPool.value: Laboon is a massive and gentle whale whose loyalty has endured longer than most lifetimes. Using his immense strength and powerful headbutts, he once challenged the Red Line itself, desperate to reunite with the Rumbar Pirates who promised to return for him. Decades have passed, yet he continues to wait at Twin Cape, watched over by Crocus and cherished by those who learn his story. With no Haki and no desire for battle, Laboon’s greatest power is his unwavering heart, making him a beloved companion tied forever to the memory of the Rumbar Pirates.
cardPool.description:
Name: Laboon
Fruit/Ability: Gigantic whale strength
Weapon: Headbutts
Haki Type: None
Background story: Waiting decades for Rumbar Pirates to return
Role/Rank: Companion
Faction: Rumbar Pirates (former)
Island Location: Twin Cape

cardPool.title: Igaram
cardPool.value: Igaram is the loyal and resourceful captain of the Alabasta Royal Guard, dedicating his life to protecting Princess Vivi and the stability of their kingdom. Known for his elaborate disguises and unexpected tricks, he once infiltrated Baroque Works under the alias Mr. 8. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his ingenuity more than makes up for it—most famously shown through the machine gun cleverly hidden within his towering wig. Fiercely devoted and willing to risk everything for Vivi and Alabasta, he remains stationed in the kingdom, standing as a steadfast shield against any threat that dares approach.

cardPool.title: Miss Monday
cardPool.value: Miss Monday is a brute-force fighter once stationed in Whiskey Peak as a Frontier Agent of Baroque Works. Disguised as a nun to deceive travelers, she relied not on tricks or weapons but on her overwhelming physical strength, capable of overpowering most foes with sheer power alone. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her durability and determination made her a reliable enforcer within the organization. After Baroque Works collapsed, her whereabouts became uncertain, with most believing she remained somewhere in the East Blue. Even so, her fierce spirit and raw strength continue to define her reputation.

cardPool.title: Mr. 9
cardPool.value: Mr. 9 is an energetic and determined Frontier Agent of Baroque Works, best known for his acrobatic fighting style and unusual choice of weaponry. Armed with metal bats and hidden explosives, he blends reckless creativity with fierce loyalty, especially when working alongside his former partner, Miss Monday. Though he lacks a Devil Fruit or Haki, his agility and persistence made him a dependable combatant within the organization. After the fall of Baroque Works, his fate became unclear, with sightings suggesting he remained somewhere in the East Blue. Despite his uncertain future, his spirited nature and bold antics still leave a memorable mark.
cardPool.description:
Name: Mr. 9
Fruit/Ability: None; uses bat weapons
Weapon: Bats, explosives
Haki Type: None
Background story: Baroque Works agent; partner of Miss Monday
Role/Rank: Frontier Agent
Faction: Baroque Works
Island Location: Unknown (last seen in East Blue)

cardPool.title: Mr. 5
cardPool.value: Mr. 5 is a deadly officer agent of Baroque Works, feared for his mastery of the Bomb-Bomb Fruit which allows him to detonate any part of his body at will. Known for his creative combat style, he often combines his explosive power with unconventional weapons, including his infamous explosive snot, to catch enemies off guard. As an assassination expert, he executed missions with precision and cunning, striking fear into those who opposed the organization. Last seen in Alabasta, he remains a dangerous figure whose skill with explosives defines both his reputation and his legacy.

cardPool.title: Miss Valentine
cardPool.value: Miss Valentine is a cunning officer agent of Baroque Works, renowned for her ability to manipulate her weight at will using the Kilo-Kilo Fruit. Wielding an umbrella both as a weapon and a tool to enhance her combat strategies, she moves with deceptive agility despite her changing mass. Partnered with Mr. 5, she executed missions with precision, using her unique powers to outmaneuver and overwhelm her targets. Last seen in Alabasta, she remains a formidable operative whose cleverness and versatility make her a memorable member of the organization.

cardPool.title: Dorry
cardPool.value: Dorry is a legendary giant warrior from Elbaf, whose immense strength and unwavering resolve have defined a century-long duel on Little Garden. Wielding a massive sword, he battles with the honor and discipline of a true Elbaf warrior, each strike carrying the weight of his people’s legacy. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his raw power and experience make him a fearsome opponent to any who challenge him. His enduring fight, now lasting over 100 years, stands as a testament to his dedication, courage, and the indomitable spirit of Elbaf.

cardPool.title: Brogy
cardPool.value: Brogy is a formidable giant warrior from Elbaf, known for his immense strength and skill with a massive axe. As the long-standing rival of Dorry, he has engaged in a duel that has spanned over a century, each battle showcasing his unwavering determination and the pride of his people. Though he wields no Devil Fruit or Haki, his sheer size, power, and combat experience make him a terrifying force on Little Garden. Brogy’s enduring rivalry stands as a symbol of honor, courage, and the unyielding spirit of the giants of Elbaf.

cardPool.title: Mr. 3
cardPool.value: Mr. 3 is a cunning and strategic officer agent of Baroque Works, notorious for his ability to manipulate wax through the Wax-Wax Fruit. Using candle-based traps and solid wax constructs, he outsmarts and ensnares opponents with precision and creativity. Known for his deceptive tactics, he thrives on planning and trickery rather than brute force. After the fall of Baroque Works, he allied himself with Buggy, now operating from Karai Bari Island, where his intelligence and resourcefulness continue to make him a dangerous and unpredictable figure.

cardPool.title: Miss Goldenweek
cardPool.value: Miss Goldenweek is a young and enigmatic officer agent of Baroque Works, whose artistic talents hide a dangerous power. Using her Color Trap ability, she manipulates the emotions of others through the vibrant paint from her brush, turning creativity into a weapon. Though she wields no Devil Fruit or Haki, her skill in psychological manipulation makes her a formidable opponent despite her youthful appearance. Last seen in the Alabasta region, she remains a mysterious figure whose colorful illusions and cunning tactics leave a lasting impression on anyone who crosses her path.
cardPool.description:
Name: Miss Goldenweek
Fruit/Ability: Color Trap (emotion control via paint)
Weapon: Paintbrush
Haki Type: None
Background story: Young Baroque Works artist with strange powers
Role/Rank: Officer Agent
Faction: Baroque Works
Island Location: Unknown (possibly Alabasta region)

cardPool.title: Doctor Kureha
cardPool.value: Doctor Kureha is a legendary medical genius of Drum Island, whose age-defying vitality and unparalleled knowledge have earned her worldwide renown. Armed with needles, potions, and decades of experience, she has saved countless lives and serves as the mentor to Chopper, guiding him in both medicine and wisdom. Though she wields no Devil Fruit or Haki, her intellect, skill, and sharp wit make her a force to be reckoned with in any medical emergency. Residing in the Sakura Kingdom on Drum Island, she continues to practice her craft with energy and determination that belie her years, remaining a cornerstone of the island’s well-being.

cardPool.title: Dalton
cardPool.value: Dalton is the strong and honorable King of the Sakura Kingdom on Drum Island, whose loyalty and courage have defined his rise from former guard under Wapol to revolutionary leader. Empowered by the Ox-Ox Fruit, he can transform into a massive bison, amplifying his already formidable strength in combat. Though he possesses no Haki, his bravery, skill, and steadfast sense of justice make him a respected ruler and protector of his people. Standing as both king and warrior, Dalton continues to defend Drum Island with unwavering determination and heart.
cardPool.description:
Name: Dalton
Fruit/Ability: Ox-Ox Fruit, Bison form
Weapon: Strength
Haki Type: None
Background story: Former guard under Wapol, turned revolutionary
Role/Rank: King of Sakura Kingdom
Faction: Drum Island
Island Location: Drum Island

cardPool.title: Wapol
cardPool.value: Wapol is a once-greedy monarch of the Black Drum Kingdom, notorious for his selfish rule and insatiable appetite. With the power of the Munch-Munch Fruit, he can consume and merge objects, often using this ability to create bizarre and destructive weaponry. After being overthrown, he reinvented himself as the CEO of Evil Black Drum, continuing his schemes and maintaining influence through cunning and technology. Though he possesses no Haki, his ambition and resourcefulness make him a persistent and unpredictable force. Now present at Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Wapol remains a reminder of the dangers of unchecked greed and ingenuity.

cardPool.title: Nefertari Vivi
cardPool.value: Nefertari Vivi is the courageous princess of Alabasta, known for her intelligence, combat skill, and unwavering dedication to her people. Wielding her distinctive Peacock Slashers, she blends elegance and precision to defend those she cares for. To protect her kingdom, she once infiltrated Baroque Works under the alias Miss Wednesday, navigating dangerous deception with grace and courage. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her leadership, strategy, and bravery make her a respected figure both in Alabasta and among her allies. She is currently present at Mary Geoise during the Reverie, representing her kingdom with dignity and resolve.
cardPool.description:
Name: Nefertari Vivi
Fruit/Ability: None; skilled in peacock slashers
Weapon: Peacock Slashers
Haki Type: None
Background story: Princess of Alabasta; infiltrated Baroque Works as Miss Wednesday
Role/Rank: Princess
Faction: Alabasta Kingdom (former Straw Hat ally)
Island Location: Mary Geoise (Reverie)

cardPool.title: Crocodile
cardPool.value: Crocodile is a cunning and ruthless former Warlord of the Sea, once the secret leader of Baroque Works and a master of manipulation. Empowered by the Sand-Sand Fruit, he can create and control sand to bury, slice, or dehydrate his enemies, making him a deadly force in battle. Wielding a hooked weapon tipped with poison or a blade, he combines his Devil Fruit power with lethal precision. Though Armament Haki is implied post-timeskip, his strategic mind and experience make him as dangerous without it. Now aligned with Cross Guild on Karai Bari Island, Crocodile continues to exert his influence with calculated strength and unwavering ambition.

cardPool.title: Bon Clay
cardPool.value: Bon Clay, also known as Mr. 2, is a flamboyant and loyal former agent of Baroque Works, famed for his mastery of Okama Kenpo and the transformative powers of the Clone-Clone Fruit, which allows him to perfectly mimic anyone he touches. Beyond his combat abilities, his heart and loyalty have forged deep friendships, most notably with Luffy, proving that courage and camaraderie define him as much as skill. Now serving as Vice-Warden of New Kama Land within Impel Down’s Level 5.5, he uses both his martial arts and Devil Fruit powers to protect and inspire those under his care. Though he lacks Haki, his charisma, agility, and cunning make him a formidable and unforgettable figure.
cardPool.description:
Name: Bon Clay (Mr. 2)
Fruit/Ability: Clone-Clone Fruit (copy appearances by touch)
Weapon: Martial arts (Okama Kenpo)
Haki Type: None
Background story: Loyal Baroque Works agent who befriended Luffy
Role/Rank: Vice-Warden (New Kama Land)
Faction: Baroque Works (former), New Kama Land
Island Location: Impel Down, Level 5.5 (New Kama Land)

cardPool.title: Miss Doublefinger
cardPool.value: Miss Doublefinger is a skilled officer agent of Baroque Works, recognized for her precision and deadly combat abilities. Wielding sharp, blade-like fingers enhanced by her powers, she attacks with speed and accuracy, making her a dangerous opponent in close quarters. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her agility, strength, and tactical mind make her a formidable enforcer within the organization. Last seen operating under Baroque Works, she remains a calculating and lethal presence, capable of turning any situation to her advantage with deadly efficiency.

cardPool.title: Mr. 4
cardPool.value: Mr. 4 is a powerful officer agent of Baroque Works, known for his immense strength and unyielding endurance in battle. Wielding a massive hammer, he delivers devastating blows capable of crushing nearly anything in his path. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his brute force, resilience, and tactical use of his weapon make him a dangerous combatant and a reliable enforcer within the organization. Last seen in Alabasta, he remains a formidable figure whose presence on the battlefield inspires both fear and respect.

cardPool.title: Miss Merry Christmas
cardPool.value: Miss Merry Christmas is a formidable officer agent of Baroque Works, known for her immense strength and towering presence. Skilled in physical combat, she wields her massive size and power to crush enemies with overwhelming force. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her durability, strategic mind, and relentless determination make her a feared combatant within the organization. Last seen in Alabasta, she remains an imposing figure whose loyalty and ferocity define her role among Baroque Works’ elite agents.

cardPool.title: Lassoo
cardPool.value: Lassoo is a unique and dangerous weapon of Baroque Works, a firearm transformed into a living dog by the Dog-Dog Fruit: Gun Model. Capable of independent movement and intelligence, Lassoo attacks with exploding baseballs and other inventive projectiles, blending animal agility with deadly firepower. Though it possesses no Haki, its Devil Fruit abilities make it a highly unpredictable and formidable opponent on the battlefield. Last seen in Alabasta, Lassoo serves as both a loyal companion to its handler and a lethal instrument of Baroque Works’ operations.
cardPool.description:
Name: Lassoo
Fruit/Ability: Dog-Dog Fruit: Gun model (gun turned dog)
Weapon: Exploding baseballs
Haki Type: None
Background story: A gun that ate a Devil Fruit
Role/Rank: Animal weapon
Faction: Baroque Works
Island Location: Alabasta

cardPool.title: Pell
cardPool.value:
Name: Pell
Fruit/Ability: Falcon-Falcon Fruit
Weapon: Sword
Haki Type: None
Background story: Guardian of Alabasta, known as the “Strongest Warrior”
Role/Rank: Guardian
Faction: Alabasta Kingdom
Island Location: Alabasta

cardPool.title: Chaka
cardPool.value: Chaka is the loyal captain of the Alabasta Royal Guard, devoted to protecting King Cobra and the kingdom at all costs. With the power of the Jackal-Jackal Fruit, he can transform into a jackal, enhancing his speed, agility, and combat effectiveness. Wielding a sword with skill and precision, he combines his Devil Fruit abilities with masterful swordsmanship to defend his homeland. Though he possesses no Haki, his unwavering loyalty, leadership, and dedication make him a formidable protector, ensuring the safety and honor of Alabasta.

cardPool.title: King Cobra
cardPool.value: King Cobra is the wise and benevolent ruler of Alabasta, known for his political acumen and unwavering dedication to his people. Though he wields no weapon, Devil Fruit powers, or Haki, his leadership, diplomacy, and strategic mind allow him to navigate threats both internal and external, striving to preserve the peace and prosperity of his kingdom. Having faced crises such as Baroque Works’ infiltration, he remains a respected and honorable figure. Last seen at Mary Geoise during the Reverie, King Cobra continues to represent Alabasta with dignity and a steadfast commitment to justice.

cardPool.title: Koza
cardPool.value: Koza is the fearless leader of Alabasta’s rebels and a loyal ally of Princess Vivi, with whom he shares a childhood bond. Skilled in desert combat, he wields dual sabers with speed and precision, leading his forces with strategy and courage. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his determination, leadership, and dedication to protecting Alabasta make him a formidable figure on the battlefield. Now allied with the royal family, Koza continues to defend his homeland and support Vivi in preserving the peace and prosperity of the kingdom.

cardPool.title: Toto
cardPool.value: Toto is a humble and kind-hearted civilian of Alabasta, known as the father of Koza. Armed only with a shovel, he has shown courage and resourcefulness when aiding many known Pirates, Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his bravery, loyalty, and willingness to protect others make him a respected figure among his community. Remaining in Alabasta, Toto continues to live a simple life while supporting the safety and well-being of those around him.

cardPool.title: Eyelashes
cardPool.value: Eyelashes is the spirited and loyal pet of Princess Vivi, a super spot-billed duck known for remarkable speed and agility. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his quickness and intelligence make him a reliable companion and mount for Vivi during travel and combat situations. Always attentive and protective, Eyelashes serves as both a friend and ally, faithfully accompanying the princess across Alabasta and proving that even the smallest creatures can have a big impact.

cardPool.title: Bellamy
cardPool.value: Bellamy is a daring pirate captain known for his mockery of others’ dreams and his explosive spring-based combat. Empowered by the Spring-Spring Fruit, he can transform his limbs into powerful springs, delivering rapid and devastating attacks with precision and force. Wielding only his fists enhanced by his Devil Fruit, he complements his power with post-timeskip mastery of Armament Haki. Once a rival to many in the New World, he later allied with the Donquixote Pirates under Doflamingo. Last seen on Dressrosa, Bellamy remains a bold and unpredictable force whose speed and strength define his presence on the seas.

cardPool.title: Sarquiss
cardPool.value: Sarquiss is the loyal first mate of the Bellamy Pirates, known for his skill with a sword and his steadfast support of his captain. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his combat ability and loyalty make him a reliable crewmate in battle. He faced powerful adversaries alongside Bellamy but was ultimately defeated by Blackbeard. Last seen on Jaya, Sarquiss remains a testament to dedication and resilience, representing the strength of those who serve faithfully under their captain.
cardPool.description:
Name: Sarquiss
Fruit/Ability: None
Weapon: Sword
Haki Type: None
Background story: Bellamy’s crewmate, defeated by Blackbeard
Role/Rank: First Mate
Faction: Bellamy Pirates
Island Location: Jaya (last seen)

cardPool.title: Blackbeard
cardPool.value: Blackbeard, also known as Marshall D. Teach, is a cunning and ruthless pirate whose ambition knows no bounds. Once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates, he orchestrated his rise to Yonko status through betrayal, manipulation, and unmatched opportunism. Empowered by both the Dark-Dark Fruit and the Tremor-Tremor Fruit, he wields devastating powers capable of crushing foes and reshaping the battlefield. Armed with a claw and pistol, and skilled in Armament and Observation Haki, he combines brute force with tactical genius. Following the Payback War, where he defeated the remnants of Whitebeard’s crew, Blackbeard now commands the Blackbeard Pirates from Hachinosu, solidifying his position as one of the most dangerous men on the seas.
cardPool.description:
Name: Blackbeard (Marshall D. Teach)
Fruit/Ability: Dark-Dark Fruit (absorbs anything)
Weapon: Claw and pistol
Haki Type: Armament, Observation
Background story: Former Whitebeard Pirate; plotted his rise to Yonko
Role/Rank: Yonko
Faction: Blackbeard Pirates
Island Location: Hachinosu (Pirate Island)

cardPool.title: Doc Q
cardPool.value: Doc Q is the eerie and seemingly frail doctor of the Blackbeard Pirates, whose true threat lies in his mastery of the Sick-Sick Fruit, allowing him to inflict devastating diseases on his enemies. Wielding a scythe as both weapon and symbol, he combines his sinister abilities with careful precision to weaken and terrorize opponents. Though he lacks Haki, his command of illness and his unsettling presence make him a dangerous figure within the crew. Stationed on Hachinosu, Doc Q serves as both healer and harbinger of sickness, embodying the dark and unpredictable nature of Blackbeard’s forces.

cardPool.title: Van Augur
cardPool.value: Van Augur is the calm and precise sniper of the Blackbeard Pirates, feared for his deadly accuracy and unshakable composure. Empowered by the Warp-Warp Fruit, he can teleport with ease, striking from unexpected angles and evading counterattacks. Wielding a sniper rifle and trained in Observation Haki, he combines long-range precision with strategic cunning to eliminate targets efficiently. Stationed on Hachinosu, Van Augur exemplifies patience, skill, and lethality, making him a cornerstone of Blackbeard’s formidable crew.

cardPool.title: Jesus Burgess
cardPool.value: Jesus Burgess is the powerhouse helmsman of the Blackbeard Pirates, renowned for his wrestling-style combat and unwavering loyalty to his captain. Empowered by the Buff-Buff Fruit, he can dramatically enhance his muscle mass, delivering devastating barehanded attacks with overwhelming force. Skilled in Armament Haki, he combines brute strength and reinforced strikes to dominate the battlefield. Stationed on Hachinosu, Burgess serves as both the crew’s frontline brawler and a symbol of raw power, embodying the fierce and relentless spirit of Blackbeard’s forces.

cardPool.title: Mont Blanc Cricket
cardPool.value: Mont Blanc Cricket is a determined and adventurous salvager from Jaya, descended from the legendary Norland and driven to uncover proof of Skypiea. Skilled in diving and hand-to-hand combat, he wields only his fists with remarkable strength and precision. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his courage, persistence, and deep connection to his family’s legacy make him a respected figure among allies and a tenacious opponent to adversaries. As a member of the Saruyama Alliance, Cricket continues his quest, uncovering the mysteries of the skies and the history of his ancestors.

cardPool.title: Masira
cardPool.value: Masira is the ape-themed and resourceful captain of the Saruyama Alliance, known for his expertise in diving and hand-to-hand combat. Wielding only his fists, he combines agility, strength, and keen instincts to navigate the dangers of the seas and salvage valuable treasures. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his leadership, experience, and unwavering determination make him a respected and capable figure among his crew. Stationed around Jaya, Masira continues to lead his team on daring expeditions, embodying the adventurous spirit of a seasoned salvager.

cardPool.title: Shoujou
cardPool.value: Shoujou is the gorilla-themed and charismatic captain of the Shoujou Pirates within the Saruyama Alliance, known for his extraordinary sonic voice capable of disorienting or damaging opponents. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, he wields his voice as a powerful weapon, turning sound into a tool of combat and control. Skilled in leadership and strategy, he guides his crew with confidence and authority. Stationed near Jaya, Shoujou continues to lead daring salvage missions, combining his unique abilities and determination to make a lasting impact on the seas.

cardPool.title: Enel
cardPool.value: Enel is the self-proclaimed “God” of Skypiea, a tyrannical ruler whose god complex drove him to dominate the sky-island with fear and power. Empowered by the Rumble-Rumble Fruit, he can generate, control, and transform into lightning, using his gold staff to amplify attacks and assert control. Skilled in Observation Haki, or Mantra, he can predict movements and sense the intentions of others, making him nearly untouchable in combat. After his reign on Skypiea, he set his sights on new worlds, eventually residing on Fairy Vearth, the moon, with his priests, continuing to wield his immense power with divine authority.

cardPool.title: Wyper
cardPool.value: Wyper is a fierce Shandian warrior, determined to reclaim his homeland from the Skypieans. Skilled in the use of Seastone weapons and dials, he wields a Burn Bazooka and Reject Dial with deadly precision, combining technology and combat prowess to devastating effect. Though Armament Haki is implied, his discipline, strength, and strategic mind make him a formidable opponent even without it. Fighting for the honor and freedom of his people, Wyper stands as a symbol of Shandian resilience and courage on Skypiea, unyielding in his mission to protect and reclaim his land.

cardPool.title: Gan Fall
cardPool.value: Gan Fall is the noble and experienced former God of Skypiea, revered for his wisdom, courage, and dedication to his people. Riding Pierre, a flying bird-horse, he commands both mobility and presence on the battlefield. Skilled with a lance and dials, he combines traditional combat with strategic use of Skypiea’s technology. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his leadership, bravery, and knowledge make him a formidable protector. Now serving as a Knight of the Sky, Gan Fall continues to safeguard Skypiea and guide allies, including the Straw Hat Pirates, with unwavering honor.

cardPool.title: Conis
cardPool.value: Conis is a resourceful and courageous Sky Islander from Skypiea, known for aiding the Straw Hat Pirates in their escape and supporting allies in times of need. Skilled in riding her sky bike, Waver, she navigates the skies with agility and precision. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her quick thinking, bravery, and determination make her a reliable and valued companion. Remaining on Skypiea, Conis continues to protect her home and assist those in need, embodying the spirit and resilience of the island’s people.

cardPool.title: Pagaya
cardPool.value: Pagaya is a skilled and inventive engineer from Skypiea, renowned for his expertise with dials and Sky Island technology. As the father of Conis, he not only guides and protects his daughter but also played a key role in repairing the Waver, ensuring safe travel across the skies. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his intelligence, craftsmanship, and resourcefulness make him indispensable to the Skypieans. Remaining on Skypiea, Pagaya continues to support his people and allies, using his technical genius to solve problems and enhance the island’s defenses.

cardPool.title: Ohm
cardPool.value: Ohm is a disciplined and formidable priest of Enel, entrusted with guarding the Iron Trial and enforcing the will of Skypiea’s self-proclaimed god. Wielding the Eisen Whip, an iron cloud sword, he combines skill, speed, and precision to dominate in combat. Trained in Observation Haki, he can anticipate enemy movements and strike with deadly accuracy. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit, his mastery of his weapon, Haki, and unwavering loyalty make him a fearsome protector of Enel’s authority. Stationed on Skypiea, Ohm serves as both guardian and enforcer, embodying the strength and discipline of Enel’s army.

cardPool.title: Gedatsu
cardPool.value: Gedatsu is a quirky yet powerful priest of Enel, assigned to guard the Swamp Trial. Despite his often clueless demeanor, he wields formidable martial arts skills, making him a dangerous opponent to any who challenge him. Trained in Observation Haki, he can sense the movements and intentions of his foes, compensating for his eccentric nature with heightened perception. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit, his strength, unpredictability, and devotion to Enel’s army make him a unique and formidable guardian. After the events of Skypiea, Gedatsu resides on Ukkari Hot-Spring Island, continuing his duties with eccentric dedication.

cardPool.title: Satori
cardPool.value: Satori is a vigilant and formidable priest of Enel, charged with guarding the Forest Trial on Skypiea. Armed with Impact and Ordeal balls, he attacks with precision and relentless force, ambushing intruders with deadly efficiency. Trained in Observation Haki, he can anticipate enemy movements and respond with strategic timing. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit, his combat skill, discipline, and loyalty to Enel make him a dangerous and reliable guardian. Stationed on Skypiea, Satori continues to enforce the will of Enel, protecting the sacred trials with unwavering vigilance.

cardPool.title: Yama
cardPool.value: Yama is the imposing commander of Enel’s Divine Soldiers, known for his immense strength and mastery of heavyweight sumo techniques. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his sheer physical power and combat skill make him a dominant force on the battlefield. Tasked with enforcing Enel’s authority, Yama combines discipline, strategy, and raw strength to maintain order and eliminate threats. Stationed on Skypiea, he serves as a formidable enforcer, embodying the might and unwavering loyalty of Enel’s army.

cardPool.title: Iceburg
cardPool.value: Iceburg is the esteemed mayor of Water 7 and president of the Galley-La Company, known for his leadership, intelligence, and dedication to his city. A former apprentice of the legendary shipwright Tom, he played a crucial role in preserving the plans for the ancient weapon Pluton. Though he wields no Devil Fruit, weapon, or Haki, his strategic mind, influence, and craftsmanship make him a pivotal figure in both politics and shipbuilding. Stationed in Water 7, Iceburg continues to guide his city with wisdom, integrity, and a commitment to its safety and prosperity.

cardPool.title: Paulie
cardPool.value: Paulie is a loudmouthed yet loyal shipwright of the Galley-La Company, known for his skill in rope-based combat and his dedication to his craft. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his strength, ingenuity, and determination make him a reliable ally and a valuable protector of Water 7’s shipbuilding industry. A candidate to join the Straw Hat crew, Paulie’s loyalty and courage have repeatedly proven essential in both daily life and battle. Stationed in Water 7, he continues to support his city and colleagues with unwavering commitment.

cardPool.title: Rob Lucci
cardPool.value: Rob Lucci is the most lethal and calculating assassin of CP9, now serving CP0, known for his unmatched skill and ruthless efficiency. Empowered by the awakened Cat-Cat Fruit: Leopard, he can transform into a leopard, gaining incredible speed, strength, and combat prowess while enhancing the destructive potential of his abilities. Mastery of Rokushiki techniques, combined with Armament and Observation Haki, makes him a formidable force capable of overwhelming even the strongest opponents. Following the Egghead incident, Lucci has returned to active duty, continuing to serve with precision and dedication across the world as a feared and highly skilled agent.

cardPool.title: Kaku
cardPool.value: Kaku is a highly skilled CP9 agent, now serving CP0, who once operated under the guise of a Galley-La shipwright. Empowered by the Giraffe-Giraffe Fruit, he can transform into a giraffe, granting him extended reach, immense strength, and enhanced combat versatility. A master of swordsmanship combined with Rokushiki techniques, Kaku also wields Armament and Observation Haki, making him a deadly and adaptable opponent. After the events on Egghead Island, he continues to carry out his duties as a formidable and strategic agent, feared for both his power and precision in combat.
cardPool.description:
Name: Kaku
Fruit/Ability: Giraffe-Giraffe Fruit
Weapon: Swordsmanship with Rokushiki
Haki Type: Armament, Observation
Background story: CP9 agent disguised as a Galley-La shipwright
Role/Rank: Agent
Faction: CP0 (formerly CP9)
Island Location: Egghead Island

cardPool.title: Blueno
cardPool.value: Blueno is a skilled and versatile CP9 agent, now serving CP0, known for his mastery of Rokushiki and strategic combat abilities. Empowered by the Door-Door Fruit, he can create interdimensional doors, allowing him to transport himself and others instantaneously, attack from unexpected angles, and manipulate the battlefield with precision. Trained in Armament Haki after the timeskip, Blueno combines his Devil Fruit powers with enhanced combat resilience, making him a formidable opponent. Following the events on Egghead Island, he continues to operate as a highly efficient and feared agent, executing missions with cunning and efficiency.

cardPool.title: Kalifa
cardPool.value: Kalifa is a cunning and agile agent, formerly serving as Iceburg’s secretary before revealing her true identity as a member of CP9, now CP0. Empowered by the Bubble-Bubble Fruit, she can create and manipulate soap for attacks, traps, and movement, often using a soap whip in combat. Though she possesses no Haki, her speed, agility, and strategic mind make her a dangerous and unpredictable opponent. After the events on Egghead Island, Kalifa continues to operate as a skilled and efficient agent, executing missions with precision and cunning.

cardPool.title: Jabra
cardPool.value: Jabra is a deceptive and fierce CP9 agent, now serving CP0, known for his cunning, combat skill, and rivalry with Rob Lucci. Empowered by the Wolf-Wolf Fruit, he can transform into a wolf, gaining enhanced speed, strength, and agility, while utilizing sharp claws to devastate opponents. Skilled in Rokushiki techniques, Jabra combines his Devil Fruit abilities with martial prowess to dominate the battlefield. Following the events on Egghead Island, he continues to operate as a dangerous and strategic agent, feared for both his ferocity and his clever tactics.

cardPool.title: Fukurou
cardPool.value: Fukurou is a clever and strategic CP9 agent, skilled in information-based combat and deception. Using his unique zipper-mouth ability alongside Rokushiki techniques, he can manipulate, restrain, and confuse opponents with precision. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his intelligence, cunning, and mastery of specialized combat tactics make him a formidable operative. Last seen at Enies Lobby, Fukurou operates with discretion and efficiency, embodying the lethal professionalism of CP9 agents.

cardPool.title: Kumadori
cardPool.value: Kumadori is a dramatic and eccentric CP9 agent, known for his theatrical fighting style and unique techniques. Skilled with a staff and capable of using the Life Return technique to manipulate his own body for enhanced combat performance, he blends flair with deadly precision. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his creativity, agility, and mastery of specialized combat skills make him a formidable opponent. Last seen at Enies Lobby, Kumadori embodies the unpredictable and dangerous nature of CP9 operatives.

cardPool.title: Spandam
cardPool.value: Spandam is the corrupt and ambitious director of CP0, formerly the leader of CP9, driven by obsession with power and his own twisted sense of justice. Armed with Funkfreed, a unique sword-elephant hybrid, he wields a weapon capable of both offense and intimidation. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his authority, cunning, and manipulation make him a dangerous figure in the shadows of the World Government. Operating from Egghead Island, Spandam continues to exert control and influence, enforcing his agenda with ruthless determination.

cardPool.title: Funkfreed
cardPool.value: Funkfreed is a unique and formidable weapon, empowered by the Elephant-Elephant Fruit (Zoan), allowing it to transform from a sword into a living elephant. Loyal to Spandam, it serves as both a powerful offensive tool and a versatile combat companion. Though it possesses no Haki, its immense strength, adaptability, and durability make it a fearsome presence on the battlefield. As Spandam’s living weapon, Funkfreed operates alongside him on Egghead Island, embodying both loyalty and raw destructive power.

cardPool.title: Tom
cardPool.value: Tom is a legendary shipwright from Water 7, renowned for his unmatched skill and craftsmanship, most famously for constructing the Oro Jackson, the ship of the Pirate King. Possessing Fishman strength, he wields incredible physical power alongside his technical genius, though he uses no weapons or Haki. Respected by apprentices and peers alike, Tom’s influence shaped the next generation of shipwrights, including Iceburg. Stationed in Water 7, he remains a symbol of masterful shipbuilding and enduring legacy in the world of nautical engineering.

cardPool.title: Kokoro
cardPool.value: Kokoro is a kind and experienced merfolk, serving as the train conductor and stationmaster of the Sea Train in Water 7. With exceptional swimming skills and deep knowledge of maritime operations, she assists Tom and guides passengers safely across the waters. Though she wields no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, her wisdom, care, and reliability make her an indispensable figure in the community, acting as a grandmotherly presence to Chimney and others. Stationed in Water 7, Kokoro continues to ensure the smooth operation of the Sea Train and the safety of those who travel with her.

cardPool.title: Chimney
cardPool.value: Chimney is the spirited granddaughter of Kokoro, growing up under her guidance and assisting with the Sea Train operations in Water 7. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, her curiosity, bravery, and eagerness to help make her a valued member of the crew and a loyal companion to those she trusts. Chimney demonstrates courage beyond her years, embodying the energy and optimism of the next generation. Stationed in Water 7, she continues to learn and aid in the day-to-day operations of the Sea Train.

cardPool.title: T-Bone
cardPool.value: T-Bone is a compassionate and honorable Marine captain from the South Blue, known for his dedication to protecting civilians and upholding justice. Wielding a long, thin sword with skill and precision, he combines bravery with tactical intelligence in combat. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, his courage, leadership, and selflessness make him a respected figure among both Marines and civilians. Tragically, T-Bone gave his life while defending innocents, leaving behind a legacy of heroism and integrity.

cardPool.title: Franky Family
cardPool.value: The Franky Family is a loyal and resourceful gang led by Franky, dedicated to protecting the Water 7 shipyard and supporting their leader even after he departed. Skilled in brawling, inventive use of bikes, and firearms, they combine street smarts with combat ability to defend their territory. Though they possess no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, their loyalty, teamwork, and determination make them a formidable group in the streets of Water 7. Operating throughout the city, the Franky Family continues to uphold their reputation as protectors and enforcers within the community.

cardPool.title: Gecko Moria
cardPool.value: Gecko Moria is a former Warlord of the Sea, infamous for his dark and cunning nature. Empowered by the Shadow-Shadow Fruit, he can manipulate shadows to create powerful zombie minions and attack foes, often using a pair of scissors to sever and control shadows. Though he possesses no Haki, his mastery of shadows, strategic mind, and unpredictable tactics make him a dangerous adversary. As captain of the Mysterious Four, Moria last operated from Pirate Island before disappearing, leaving a legacy of terror and dark experimentation in his wake.

cardPool.title: Perona
cardPool.value: Perona is a whimsical yet deadly commander, formerly loyal to Gecko Moria on Thriller Bark. Empowered by the Hollow-Hollow Fruit, she can summon ghosts that induce depression in enemies or explode on command, often using her Negative Hollows to control the battlefield.
